channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: ECB Press Conference: Lagarde comments on policy outlook after raising key rates by 25 bps
item.description: Christine Lagarde, President of the European Central Bank (ECB), explains the ECB's decision to raise key rates by 25 basis points (bps) at the September policy meeting and responds to questions from the press.

item.title: Gold slides as US PPI reinforces Fed hike expectations, US Dollar and yields rise
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its decline during American trading hours on Thursday as a recovery in the US Dollar (USD), rising US Treasury yields and Federal Reserve (Fed) rate-hike expectations weigh on the precious metal, while traders also assess the latest US Producer Price Index (PPI) data.

item.title: Lagarde speech: Surprised by economic resilience
item.description: Christine Lagarde, President of the European Central Bank (ECB), explains the ECB's decision to raise key rates by 25 basis points (bps) at the September policy meeting and responds to questions from the press.

item.title: Gold: Near-term selling may only delay next leg higher - TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities’ Ryan McKay and Bart Melek note that Gold is outperforming other precious metals even as higher energy prices and rising Fed hike expectations weigh on the complex.

item.title: Lagarde speech: Can't anticipate what will be the next move
item.description: Christine Lagarde, President of the European Central Bank (ECB), explains the ECB's decision to raise key rates by 25 basis points (bps) at the September policy meeting and responds to questions from the press.

item.title: WTI US Oil rebounds toward $97 as US-Iran conflict escalates
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) US Oil rises sharply on Thursday, trading around $97.00 per barrel at the time of writing, up 2.93% on the day.

item.title: Lagarde speech: Inflation to return to target towards end of 2027
item.description: Christine Lagarde, President of the European Central Bank (ECB), explains the ECB's decision to raise key rates by 25 basis points (bps) at the September policy meeting and responds to questions from the press.

item.title: Euro weakens despite ECB rate hike as US PPI comes in hot
item.description: EUR/USD extends its intraday decline on Thursday as a recovery in the US Dollar (USD) weighs on the Euro (EUR), while the European Central Bank’s (ECB) widely expected rate hike fails to offer support.

item.title: US headline Producer Price Index rose by 5.4% in August
item.description: The US Producer Price Index (PPI) rose 5.4% in August from a year earlier, according to the latest figures from the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS). The print came in just above estimates (5.3%) and the 4.8% gain recorded in the previous month (revised from 4.7%).

item.title: Canada: Limited trade shock from new U.S. tariffs – RBC
item.description: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) economist Nathan Janzen assesses that new U.S. tariff retaliation and import bans on selected Canadian products represent a modest escalation in the trade dispute.

item.title: US Initial Jobless Claims dropped to 206K last week
item.description: According to a report from the US Department of Labour (DOL) released on Thursday, the number of US citizens submitting new applications for unemployment insurance decreased to 206K for the week ending September 5.

item.title: Norwegian Krone: Softer inflation trims hike odds – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman's (BBH) Elias Haddad notes Norwegian Krone (NOK) underperformance after Norway’s mixed August Consumer Price Index (CPI) data reduced the perceived likelihood of a near-term Norges Bank hike, with September odds falling from 65% to 38%.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: RSI signals exhaustion after a steep 4% decline
item.description: GBP/JPY edges higher on Wednesday as the Japanese Yen (JPY) weakens across the board, likely reflecting some profit-taking after the currency’s strong run since the start of the month.

item.title: Euro: Upside bias within defined band against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann describe EUR/USD as range-bound near 1.1630, with recent trading contained between 1.1619 and 1.1653. They maintain an upside bias but expect the Euro to stay within 1.1585–1.1670 in the coming weeks.

item.title: Polish Zloty: Scope for weakness against Euro as NBP underwhelms – ING
item.description: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky reports that the National Bank of Poland left rates at 3.75% and provided limited new guidance, shifting focus to Governor Glapinski’s press conference. With markets already pricing around 85bp of tightening, ING sees a high bar for a hawkish surprise.

item.title: United States Dollar Index turns positive ahead of US PPI data
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) claws back its early losses and turns positive ahead of the United States (US) Producer Price Index (PPI) data for August, which will be published at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Euro ticks down from session highs ahead of the ECB monetary policy decision
item.description: The Euro (EUR) has given away previous gains against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, pulling back to the 1.1620 area, from session highs above 1.1640.

item.title: US Dollar: CPI and Fed path guide Greenback – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) Elias Haddad highlights that the US Dollar Index (DXY) is trading just above recent lows and below its 200-day moving average, with the upcoming United States (US) August Consumer Price Index (CPI) seen as the key driver for the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) September 16 deci

item.title: Japanese Yen: Strength stabilising against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note USD/JPY weakness is stabilising around 153.45 after a drop to 152.92 and recovery to 153.54. They now expect consolidation between 153.00 and 154.30 intraday.

item.title: US Treasury yields hit fresh long-term highs amid surging Oil prices, bond buybacks
item.description: The yield for the 30-year US Treasury note trades above 5.3%, nearing the 2007 high, when Lehman Brothers collapsed. The benchmark US 10-year hit a 4.865% high earlier on Thursday, accumulating a 25 basis point rally in less than two weeks and a whole half point since late June.

item.title: What is giving the Japanese Yen room to appreciate across Asia-Pacific currencies?
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) continues to play a central role in reshaping broader macro dynamics, with its recent appreciation easing trade-weighted exchange rate pressures across Asia-Pacific (APAC) currencies and creating room for nominal appreciation in regional peers.

item.title: Canadian Dollar weakens against US Dollar ahead of key US inflation data
item.description: USD/CAD trades around 1.3820 on Thursday at the time of writing, up 0.11% on the day. The pair edges higher as investors await the release of the United States (US) Producer Price Index (PPI) data for August, scheduled for 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Indian Rupee hits fresh 10-day low amid boiling oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its losing run against the US Dollar (USD) for the third trading day on Thursday. The USD/INR pair posts a fresh 10-day high at 95.47 as the ongoing rally in oil prices continues to batter the Indian currency.

item.title: Euro: Yield support into ECB decision – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman highlights that EUR/USD has been gradually moving higher, supported by more energy-sensitive European yields and expectations of a hawkish ECB.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD tumbles below $66 as US Dollar recovers ahead of US PPI data
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) slides 2.3% to near $65.80 during the European trading session on Thursday. The white metal comes under pressure as the US Dollar (USD) turns slightly positive, with investors awaiting the United States (US) Producer Price Index (PPI) data for August releasing at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Gradual upside within capped range against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann see AUD/USD steady near 0.7220 after quiet sessions, with intraday ranges around 0.7205–0.7238. They maintain that the Australian Dollar could edge higher but expect gains to stay within 0.7160–0.7240 over the next 1–3 weeks.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD holds below $4,400 with Oil, yields surging
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) edges lower on Thursday after failing to find acceptance above $4,400, with Oil prices nearing the key $100 level and global yields rallying ahead of a string of monetary policy decisions from most of the world’s major central banks.

item.title: Turkish Lira: Liquidity stance key for TRY – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose expects the Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye (CBRT) to keep the one-week repo rate at 37.0%, but stresses that effective monetary conditions depend on liquidity tools.

item.title: Czech Koruna: CNB stance leaves room for weakness against Euro – ING
item.description: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky notes that the Czech National Bank (CNB) blackout period has started, with Deputy Governor Zamrazilova signalling a preference to keep rates unchanged at next week’s meeting.

item.title: US Dollar: Bond buybacks reshape yield dynamics – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes that the US Dollar has softened over summer as the US Treasury’s announcement to at least double long-term bond buybacks undermined confidence while inflation risks rise.
